How link's two access columns disagree, per species

Source: R/link_access_check.R
knw_link_access_check.Rd

In a link default build, streams_habitat_<sp>.accessible and streams_access.access_<sp> disagree (link#349; cause not established), and rearing and spawning are set on segments streams_access blocks. The evidence build gates on streams_access, and writes this cross-tabulation to its ledger on every run so a change between link runs shows.

Usage

knw_link_access_check(conn, schema, species = knw_species())

Arguments

conn

a DBI connection to a database holding schema.

schema

character(1) link persist schema.

species

character species with a habitat table and an access column in the schema; a species lacking either is skipped and named in skipped.

Value

A list: check, a tibble with one row per species and cell (habitat_accessible, access_gt0, n_segments, n_rearing, n_spawning, km), and skipped, the species not checked.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres())
knw_link_access_check(conn, "fresh_default", c("BT", "CH", "RB", "KO"))$check
} # }
